notes.title: Version 1.1.0 is now available
notes.notes:
Just a couple of front-facing changes this week, though the background work was large. Full details here.

* Redid the music and the underlying music system. 
* Added a global wave counter to the game's website.

So yeah, boot up the game, send in those wave counts, and... let's hit a 
million? Thanks for playing!

notes.title: Version 1.0.4 is now available
notes.notes:
As noted, the main fix here is D-pad support. You can use your controller's D-pad the same as keyboard keys now, instead of tapping rapidly--as intended.

More details about the other, more minor fixes here: 
https://epiblitikos.games/devlog/2020/07/31/convergence-compulsion-1.0.4-patch-notes

Happy Release Day! And thanks for playing!
